title: Fox News viewers 'nauseated' by 'embarrassing' Jesse Watters after Trump boast backfires - NewsBreak
text:
By JORGE SOLIS ,
2 hours ago
Jesse Watters boasted about President Donald Trump signing his half of the peace deal with Iran, which irked conservatives online.
On June 17, during the broadcast of Jesse Watters Primetime on Fox News , the conservative host discussed President Trump's handling of the peace deal. During the president's trip to Versailles, Paris, where he would meet with French President Emmanuel Macron, 48, and French First Lady Brigitte Macron, 73, Trump announced he had signed the deal. In the footage, he shouted to the cameras, "It's signed! We signed it in Versailles!"
Watters smiled at the camera and started with, "They do call him daddy." This came after the Fox News host issued a scathing verdict on the 2026 FIFA World Cup and slammed "foreign hunks."
Watters said, "Wee Wee. Trump just landed in Paris. After the G7, 47 swung through the French capital to commemorate America 250. The Treaty of Paris ended the Revolutionary War. They toasted the occasion in the world's largest royal palace.President Trump signed the Iran deal over dinner."
"They snapped a pic of the sheet and emailed it to the gay Ayatollah. Without wifi, they'll probably get it Friday," Watters said before he blurted out, "Deals seem to turn Trump on!"
Jesse Watters praised President Trump for signing the Iran peace deal He continued, "And Primetime just got our hands on the deal! We read it three times. It's only two pages! The headline: Iran's nuke program is over! Forever!"
Viewers took to social media to slam Watter's comments, arguing that the peace deal seemed insignificant.
One person said, "Why do so many people feel nauseated over this?"
